<!-- vault:html -->
*Keys to the Vault* is a short guide for teachers who are new to learning games: what to look for in a game, how to  
introduce one, and how to talk about it with students afterwards. It's free to download as a PDF.

<!-- vault:html -->
&#123;{&lt; image src="https://vaultlearninggames.org/sq/img/site/keys-to-the-vault-080469.jpg" alt="The cover of the Keys to the Vault guide" align="left" &gt;}}

## What's in it

<!-- vault:html -->
The guide covers choosing a game for a lesson, setting it up, and leading a discussion when the game is over. Each part  
is a page or two, with examples from games in the library.
